"# Implementation Plan - Fix Missing Pro Feature Modal in Lite Mode

This plan addresses the missing `pro-feature-modal` in the HTML markup of `index.html`. While the JavaScript functions `openProFeatureModal()` and `closeProFeatureModal()` are fully implemented and intercept clicks on Pro modules in Lite mode, the actual modal elements are missing from the HTML DOM, causing clicks on Pro features to fail silently without any visual feedback.

## User Review Required

> [!NOTE]
> The modal will offer users the ability to seamlessly switch to **Pro Mode** or remain in **Lite Mode**. No changes to backend APIs or core logic are required, as this is a frontend-only visual correction to restore parity with the design specifications.

## Proposed Changes

We will modify `index.html` to declare the missing `pro-feature-modal` HTML element.

### Frontend Components

---

#### [MODIFY] [index.html](file:///c:/Users/Зефирка/StartUp/index.html)

Add the `pro-feature-modal` HTML markup right before the `<!-- TOAST NOTIFICATION -->` container. The modal will match the premium glassmorphic, dark-themed style of the rest of the application, featuring:
- A title "Режим разработчика Pro" with a premium icon.
- An explanatory text warning that the selected module is a Pro feature and offering a clear option to switch to Pro mode or stay in Lite mode.
- Action buttons: "Остаться в Lite" (close modal) and "Включить режим Pro" (triggers `activateProModeFromModal()` to switch modes and navigate to the target module).

```html
    <!-- PRO FEATURE WARNING MODAL -->
    <div id="pro-feature-modal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity duration-300 opacity-0">
        <div class="bg-[#131316]/95 border border-purple-500/30 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl shadow-black/80 transform scale-95 transition-all duration-300 relative space-y-6 modal-top-gradient active-glow">\
